kinds.d: Program that plays video and audio files of many formats.
Program that plays music and organises the owner's music library.
Program that opens and shows e-book files (EPUB, MOBI and similar) and manages the owner's e-book library.

notes: Restraint-only. Media player 38->17: current leaders, built-ins and Kodi/Plex-style media centres, DVD/Blu-ray suites (PowerDVD, WinDVD, Macgo) kept as that type, RealPlayer kept as icon; dropped dead and minor players (Ogle, CorePlayer, Creative MediaSource, DivX Player, TotalMedia Theatre, Miro, MediaPortal, xine etc.) and Microsoft Movies & TV. Music player 40->14: iTunes and Winamp kept as icons; streaming-service apps (Spotify, Napster, Rdio, Rhapsody) dropped as they are subscriptions rather than library players; dead tails (Sonique, Songbird, Banshee, Groove Music, XMMS etc.) dropped. E-book reader 12->7: dropped discontinued Stanza, Blio, Bluefire Reader, OverDrive Media Console and Lektz. Gap noticed: calibre (e-book library manager) is absent from the old data and was not added (needs web pass). No new kinds.
